root_cause_found_and_it_is_NOT_cosmetic.correction_to_the_original_diagnosis: The MT was opened describing a COSMETIC pill-width mismatch at 44-character ids. That framing is WRONG and is corrected here. The defect is a real rendering bug affecting EVERY chip at any non-default editor font size and EVERY chip inside a heading block, at any id length. The 44-character id merely made it visible.
root_cause_found_and_it_is_NOT_cosmetic.mechanism: rich_editor_widget.rs painted the chip label with egui::FontId::proportional(line_layout::BASE_FONT_SIZE), a CONSTANT fixed at 15.0. The pill rect it painted the label into is derived from chip_rect_for_span over a galley laid out by layout_block_with_base(.., base_font_size), where base_font_size = state.editor_font_size() - the USER-CONFIGURED size exposed in Settings as settings-editor-font-size. Whenever that size is not exactly 15.0 the pill and the label are measured by DIFFERENT metrics: above 15.0 the label overflows its pill, below it the pill runs wide.
root_cause_found_and_it_is_NOT_cosmetic.heading_case_missed_entirely: A heading block scales further still. line_layout::block_style_with_base routes NodeKind::Heading to heading_with_base, which multiplies by HEADING_SCALE ([1.8, 1.5, 1.25]). The constant never accounted for that, so a chip in an H1 was painted at 15.0 inside a pill measured at 1.8x the editor size - a far larger mismatch than the reported symptom.
root_cause_found_and_it_is_NOT_cosmetic.proof_the_two_paths_are_now_single_sourc: line_layout.rs:325 - layout_block_atoms_with_base does `let style = block_style_with_base(block, base_font_size)`, and the hsLink atom is laid out at line 355 via text_format_for_run(&[Mark::Link{..}], style, ..). The spec now calls the SAME block_style_with_base(block, base_font_size).size. Pill metric and label metric therefore come from one helper and cannot drift.

implementation_result.fix: Added `font_size: f32` to WikilinkChipSpec, populated from block_style_with_base(block, base_font_size).size at the spec site, and changed the paint site to egui::FontId::proportional(spec.font_size). Two files, both inside allowed_paths. No behavioural change at the default 15.0 editor size, which is why every existing visual baseline stays valid.
implementation_result.font_family_checked_not_assumed: text_format_for_run selects CODE_FAMILY when style.force_monospace (code blocks). The proportional family at the paint site is nevertheless correct, because the pill overlay only exists in AtomPaint::ChipCovered contexts - top-level paragraphs and headings. Nested list/quote/code/table content is AtomPaint::Visible and has NO chip overlay (line_layout.rs:346-353). Verified rather than assumed.
